title: Tiny, cute headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#66e0ff' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#66e0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='44' ry='36' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- headband outer -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 20 50 20 Q78 20 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#4a9bd6' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- headband highlight (inner lighter stroke) -->
  <path d='M26 52 Q26 25 50 25 Q74 25 74 52' fill='none' stroke='#8fd4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left ear cup outer -->
  <rect x='12' y='46' width='20' height='26' rx='9' fill='#3a7fc4'/>
  <!-- left ear cup inner cushion -->
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='12' height='18' rx='6' fill='#8fd4ff'/>
  <!-- left ear cup shine -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- right ear cup outer -->
  <rect x='68' y='46' width='20' height='26' rx='9' fill='#3a7fc4'/>
  <!-- right ear cup inner cushion -->
  <rect x='72' y='50' width='12' height='18' rx='6' fill='#8fd4ff'/>
  <!-- right ear cup shine -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- little cute face on left cup -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='57' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M17 60 Q20 62 23 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little cute face on right cup -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='57' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M77 60 Q80 62 83 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tiny connector details on band -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#8fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#8fd4ff'/>

  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <path d='M40 30 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 l3 -1 z' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 28 l0.8 2.4 l2.4 0.8 l-2.4 0.8 l-0.8 2.4 l-0.8 -2.4 l-2.4 -0.8 l2.4 -0.8 z' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
